front: O livro de que te falei ontem acabou de ser lançado em português.
pronunciation: oo LEE-vroo jee keh chee fah-LAY ohn-TENG ah-kah-BOH jee SEHR lahn-SAH-doo eng pohr-too-GAYS.
back: The book I told you about yesterday has just been released in Portuguese.
context: Formal Portuguese keeps the preposition before the relative pronoun: 'falar DE algo' → 'o livro DE QUE te falei'. In casual speech it is often dropped ('o livro que te falei').

front: A empresa cujo diretor foi entrevistado ontem anunciou demissões.
pronunciation: ah ehm-PREH-zah KOO-zhoo jee-reh-TOHR FOY ehn-treh-vees-TAH-doo ohn-TENG ah-noon-SYOH jee-mee-SOYNGS.
back: The company whose director was interviewed yesterday announced layoffs.
context: 'Cujo/cuja/cujos/cujas' (whose) agrees with the thing possessed (diretor → cujo) and is never followed by an article ('cujo o' is wrong).

front: A cidade onde nasci mudou muito nos últimos vinte anos.
pronunciation: ah see-DAH-jee OHN-jee nah-SEE moo-DOH MOOY-too nooz OOL-chee-mooz VEEN-chee AH-nooz.
back: The city where I was born has changed a lot in the last twenty years.
context: 'Onde' only refers to places. For time, use 'em que' or 'quando': 'o ano em que nasci'.

front: Essa é a professora a quem devo minha paixão pela leitura.
pronunciation: EH-sah EH ah proh-feh-SOH-rah ah KENG DEH-voo MEE-nyah pahy-SHOWNG PEH-lah lay-TOO-rah.
back: That's the teacher to whom I owe my passion for reading.
context: As a relative pronoun, 'quem' refers to people and always follows a preposition: 'a quem', 'com quem', 'para quem'.

front: O projeto no qual trabalhamos durante meses foi finalmente aprovado.
pronunciation: oo proh-ZHEH-too noo KWAHL trah-bah-LYAH-mooz doo-RAHN-chee MEH-zeez FOY fee-nah-oo-MEHN-chee ah-proh-VAH-doo.
back: The project we worked on for months was finally approved.
context: 'O qual / a qual / os quais / as quais' replace 'que' after prepositions and agree in gender and number: 'no qual' = em + o qual.

front: As razões pelas quais ele pediu demissão nunca ficaram claras.
pronunciation: ahz rrah-ZOYNGS PEH-lahs KWAHYS EH-lee peh-JEE-oo jee-mee-SOWNG NOON-kah fee-KAH-rowng KLAH-rahs.
back: The reasons why he resigned never became clear.
context: 'Pelas quais' (por + as quais) agrees with 'razões' (feminine plural). It is the formal way to say 'the reasons why'.

front: Tudo o que você disser poderá ser usado contra você.
pronunciation: TOO-doo oo keh voh-SEH jee-SEHR poh-deh-RAH SEHR oo-ZAH-doo KOHN-trah voh-SEH.
back: Anything you say can be used against you.
context: 'Tudo o que' = everything/anything that. 'Disser' is the future subjunctive of 'dizer', required for an open future condition.

front: Quem avisa amigo é.
pronunciation: KENG ah-VEE-zah ah-MEE-goo EH.
back: A true friend is the one who warns you.
context: Proverb with 'quem' and no antecedent ('the one who'). Said right before giving someone a frank warning.

front: Os candidatos cujas propostas foram rejeitadas podem recorrer da decisão.
pronunciation: ooz kahn-jee-DAH-tooz KOO-zhahs proh-POHS-tahs FOH-rowng rreh-zhay-TAH-dahs POH-deng rreh-koh-RREHR dah deh-see-ZOWNG.
back: Candidates whose proposals were rejected can appeal the decision.
context: 'Cujas' agrees with 'propostas' (feminine plural), not with 'candidatos'.

front: Foram encontradas falhas graves no sistema de segurança do banco.
pronunciation: FOH-rowng ehn-kohn-TRAH-dahs FAH-lyahs GRAH-veez noo sees-TEH-mah jee seh-goo-RAHN-sah doo BAHN-koo.
back: Serious flaws were found in the bank's security system.
context: Analytic passive (ser + past participle). The participle agrees with the subject: 'falhas' → 'encontradas'. Typical of news reports.

front: Vendem-se apartamentos com vista para o mar.
pronunciation: VEHN-deng-see ah-pahr-tah-MEHN-tooz kohng VEES-tah PAH-rah oo MAHR.
back: Apartments with an ocean view for sale.
context: Synthetic passive with 'se': the verb agrees with the subject ('apartamentos' → 'vendem'). On real signs you'll often see 'vende-se apartamentos', which grammar books reject.

front: Aluga-se uma sala comercial no centro da cidade.
pronunciation: ah-LOO-gah-see OO-mah SAH-lah koh-mehr-SYOW noo SEHN-troo dah see-DAH-jee.
back: Commercial office for rent downtown.
context: Synthetic passive in the singular: 'aluga-se' agrees with 'uma sala'. Typical of classified ads and signs.

front: Precisa-se de vendedores com experiência.
pronunciation: preh-SEE-zah-see jee vehn-deh-DOH-reez kohng ehs-peh-ree-EHN-syah.
back: Experienced salespeople wanted.
context: Here 'se' marks an indeterminate subject, not the passive: 'precisar DE' takes a preposition, so the verb stays singular even with a plural noun.

front: O contrato será assinado pelas duas partes na semana que vem.
pronunciation: oo kohn-TRAH-too seh-RAH ah-see-NAH-doo PEH-lahz DOO-ahs PAHR-cheez nah seh-MAH-nah kee VENG.
back: The contract will be signed by both parties next week.
context: Passive in the future: 'ser' carries the tense (será) and 'pelas' (por + as) introduces the agent.

front: A ponte que está sendo construída deve ficar pronta até dezembro.
pronunciation: ah POHN-chee keh ehs-TAH SEHN-doo kohns-troo-EE-dah DEH-vee fee-KAHR PROHN-tah ah-TEH deh-ZEHM-broo.
back: The bridge being built should be ready by December.
context: Progressive passive: 'estar sendo' + participle for an action in progress. Very common in Brazil (Portugal prefers 'a ser construída').

front: Fui informado de que a reunião tinha sido cancelada.
pronunciation: FOO-ee een-fohr-MAH-doo jee keh ah rreh-oo-nee-OWNG CHEE-nyah SEE-doo kahn-seh-LAH-dah.
back: I was informed that the meeting had been cancelled.
context: Two passives: 'fui informado' and the pluperfect passive 'tinha sido cancelada'. Formally, 'informar alguém DE algo' keeps 'de' before 'que'.

front: É um assunto sobre o qual prefiro não opinar.
pronunciation: EH oong ah-SOON-too SOH-bree oo KWAHL preh-FEE-roo NOWNG oh-pee-NAHR.
back: It's a subject I'd rather not give my opinion on.
context: After two-syllable prepositions (sobre, entre, contra, durante), 'o qual' sounds more natural than 'que'.

front: Conheci uma pessoa com quem posso contar para tudo.
pronunciation: koh-nyeh-SEE OO-mah peh-SOH-ah kohng KENG POH-soo kohn-TAHR PAH-rah TOO-doo.
back: I met someone I can count on for everything.
context: 'Contar COM alguém' → 'alguém com quem posso contar'. The preposition moves in front of the relative pronoun.

front: O motivo por que ele saiu cedo ainda é um mistério.
pronunciation: oo moh-CHEE-voo pohr KEH EH-lee sah-EE-oo SEH-doo ah-EEN-dah EH oong mees-TEH-ryoo.
back: The reason he left early is still a mystery.
context: 'Por que' (two words, no accent) here means 'pelo qual'. Don't confuse it with 'porque' (because) or 'por quê' (why, at the end of a sentence).

front: Os documentos de que você precisa estão na segunda gaveta.
pronunciation: ooz doh-koo-MEHN-tooz jee keh voh-SEH preh-SEE-zah ehs-TOWNG nah seh-GOON-dah gah-VEH-tah.
back: The documents you need are in the second drawer.
context: 'Precisar DE' → 'de que você precisa'. In speech 'que você precisa' is common, but exams and formal writing expect the preposition.

front: Era uma época em que ninguém tinha celular.
pronunciation: EH-rah OO-mah EH-poh-kah eng keh neen-GENG CHEE-nyah seh-loo-LAHR.
back: It was a time when nobody had a cell phone.
context: For time, use 'em que' (or 'quando'), not 'onde'. 'Uma época onde' is very common in speech but considered incorrect.

front: O que mais me incomoda é a falta de transparência.
pronunciation: oo keh MAHYS mee een-koh-MOH-dah EH ah FAHL-tah jee trahns-pah-REHN-syah.
back: What bothers me most is the lack of transparency.
context: 'O que' opening a sentence = 'what / the thing that'. A cleft structure that puts the main point at the end.

front: Foi o Marcos quem resolveu o problema, não eu.
pronunciation: FOY oo MAHR-kooz KENG rreh-zohl-VEH-oo oo proh-BLEH-mah, NOWNG EH-oo.
back: It was Marcos who solved the problem, not me.
context: Cleft sentence 'foi X quem…' to highlight who did something. 'Foi o Marcos que resolveu' is also correct.

front: Os alunos, os quais haviam estudado muito, foram aprovados com louvor.
pronunciation: ooz ah-LOO-nooz, ooz KWAHYS ah-VEE-owng ehs-too-DAH-doo MOOY-too, FOH-rowng ah-proh-VAH-dooz kohng loh-VOHR.
back: The students, who had studied hard, passed with honors.
context: In clauses between commas, 'os quais' is a formal alternative to 'que'. 'Haviam estudado' is the written pluperfect.

front: Esta é a casa cujas janelas foram pintadas de azul.
pronunciation: EHS-tah EH ah KAH-zah KOO-zhahz zhah-NEH-lahs FOH-rowng peen-TAH-dahz jee ah-ZOOL.
back: This is the house whose windows were painted blue.
context: 'Cujas janelas' combines possession (the house's windows) with a passive verb that agrees with 'janelas'.

front: Quem tem boca vai a Roma.
pronunciation: KENG teng BOH-kah VAHY ah RROH-mah.
back: If you ask, you'll find your way.
context: Proverb with 'quem' meaning 'whoever': literally 'whoever has a mouth gets to Rome', i.e. don't be shy to ask for directions or help.

front: O acordo foi fechado sem que os acionistas fossem consultados.
pronunciation: oo ah-KOHR-doo FOY feh-SHAH-doo seng keh ooz ah-syoh-NEES-tahs FOH-seng kohn-sool-TAH-dooz.
back: The deal was closed without the shareholders being consulted.
context: 'Sem que' always takes the subjunctive; here a passive subjunctive: 'fossem consultados'.

front: Não sei a quem devo me dirigir para resolver isso.
pronunciation: NOWNG SAY ah KENG DEH-voo mee jee-ree-ZHEER PAH-rah rreh-zohl-VEHR EE-soo.
back: I don't know who I should turn to in order to sort this out.
context: 'Dirigir-se A alguém' (to address or turn to someone) → 'a quem'. Very useful in bureaucratic situations.

front: A casa foi vendida por um preço bem abaixo do mercado.
pronunciation: ah KAH-zah FOY vehn-JEE-dah pohr oong PREH-soo BENG ah-BAHY-shoo doo mehr-KAH-doo.
back: The house was sold for a price well below market value.
context: Simple analytic passive. Here 'por' introduces the price, not the agent: context tells you which.

front: Diz-se que o prédio é mal-assombrado.
pronunciation: JEES-see keh oo PREH-jee-oo EH mahl-ah-sohm-BRAH-doo.
back: It is said that the building is haunted.
context: 'Diz-se que' is the formal impersonal form. In everyday Brazilian speech: 'dizem que' or 'falam que'.

front: Muitas das decisões que foram tomadas ontem serão revistas.
pronunciation: MOOY-tahz dahz deh-see-ZOYNGS keh FOH-rowng toh-MAH-dahz ohn-TENG seh-ROWNG rreh-VEES-tahs.
back: Many of the decisions made yesterday will be reviewed.
context: 'Tomar uma decisão' (to make a decision) in the passive: 'decisões foram tomadas'. 'Revistas' is the participle of 'rever'.

front: Aquele é o escritor de cujos livros te falei.
pronunciation: ah-KEH-lee EH oo ehs-kree-TOHR jee KOO-zhooz LEE-vroos chee fah-LAY.
back: That's the writer whose books I told you about.
context: Preposition + cujo: 'falar DOS livros dele' → 'de cujos livros'. Elegant, but rare in speech.

front: O bairro onde moro é tranquilo, mas a região aonde vou todo dia é bem movimentada.
pronunciation: oo BAHY-rroo OHN-jee MOH-roo EH trahn-KWEE-loo, mahz ah rreh-zhee-OWNG ah-OHN-jee VOH TOH-doo JEE-ah EH BENG moh-vee-mehn-TAH-dah.
back: The neighborhood where I live is quiet, but the area I go to every day is very busy.
context: 'Onde' = where (location, with verbs like morar/estar). 'Aonde' = to where (with verbs of movement like ir/chegar).

front: Isso é tudo de que me lembro sobre aquela noite.
pronunciation: EE-soo EH TOO-doo jee keh mee LEHM-broo SOH-bree ah-KEH-lah NOY-chee.
back: That's all I remember about that night.
context: 'Lembrar-se DE' → 'tudo de que me lembro'. Without the pronoun 'me', 'lembrar' takes no preposition: 'tudo que lembro'.

front: A proposta, cuja aprovação depende do Senado, divide opiniões.
pronunciation: ah proh-POHS-tah, KOO-zhah ah-proh-vah-SOWNG deh-PEHN-jee doo seh-NAH-doo, jee-VEE-jee oh-pee-nee-OYNGS.
back: The proposal, whose approval depends on the Senate, divides opinion.
context: News-style sentence: 'cuja' agrees with 'aprovação' (feminine singular).

front: Será que fomos enganados?
pronunciation: seh-RAH keh FOH-mooz ehn-gah-NAH-dooz?
back: Could it be that we were tricked?
context: 'Será que…?' introduces a wondering question. 'Fomos enganados' is a passive with 'ser' in the preterite.

front: As vagas restantes serão preenchidas por ordem de chegada.
pronunciation: ahz VAH-gahz rrehs-TAHN-cheez seh-ROWNG pree-ehn-SHEE-dahs pohr OHR-deng jee sheh-GAH-dah.
back: The remaining places will be filled on a first-come, first-served basis.
context: Formal passive typical of announcements. 'Por ordem de chegada' = in order of arrival.

front: Não há nada que eu possa fazer agora.
pronunciation: NOWNG AH NAH-dah kee EH-oo POH-sah fah-ZEHR ah-GOH-rah.
back: There's nothing I can do now.
context: After a negative antecedent ('nada', 'ninguém'), the relative clause takes the subjunctive: 'que eu possa'.

front: Procuro um apartamento que tenha varanda e aceite animais.
pronunciation: proh-KOO-roo oong ah-pahr-tah-MEHN-too keh TEH-nyah vah-RAHN-dah ee ah-SAY-chee ah-nee-MAHYS.
back: I'm looking for an apartment that has a balcony and allows pets.
context: When the antecedent is hypothetical (you don't know if it exists), the relative clause uses the subjunctive: 'que tenha', 'aceite'.

front: Quem quer que tenha feito isso vai ter que se explicar.
pronunciation: KENG KEHR kee TEH-nyah FAY-too EE-soo VAHY TEHR kee see ehs-plee-KAHR.
back: Whoever did this will have to explain themselves.
context: 'Quem quer que' (whoever) requires the subjunctive: 'tenha feito' (perfect subjunctive).

front: Onde quer que você vá, leve um guarda-chuva.
pronunciation: OHN-jee KEHR kee voh-SEH VAH, LEH-vee oong GWAHR-dah-SHOO-vah.
back: Wherever you go, take an umbrella.
context: 'Onde quer que' (wherever) + present subjunctive 'vá'.

front: Este é o motivo pelo qual decidimos adiar o lançamento.
pronunciation: EHS-chee EH oo moh-CHEE-voo PEH-loo KWAHL deh-see-JEE-mooz ah-jee-AHR oo lahn-sah-MEHN-too.
back: This is the reason why we decided to postpone the launch.
context: 'Pelo qual' (por + o qual) agrees with 'motivo' (masculine singular).

front: O filme, que foi gravado inteiramente no Recife, ganhou vários prêmios.
pronunciation: oo FEE-oo-mee, keh FOY grah-VAH-doo een-tay-rah-MEHN-chee noo rreh-SEE-fee, gah-NYOH VAH-ryooz PREH-myooz.
back: The film, which was shot entirely in Recife, won several awards.
context: Non-restrictive relative clause (between commas) adding extra information, with a passive inside ('foi gravado').

front: As pessoas que moram aqui há mais tempo conhecem todos os atalhos.
pronunciation: ahs peh-SOH-ahs keh MOH-rowng ah-KEE AH MAHYS TEHM-poo koh-NYEH-seng TOH-dooz ooz ah-TAH-lyoos.
back: The people who have lived here longer know all the shortcuts.
context: Restrictive clause (no commas): it identifies which people. 'Há mais tempo' = for longer.

front: Foi-me dito que o prazo seria prorrogado.
pronunciation: FOY-mee JEE-too keh oo PRAH-zoo seh-REE-ah proh-rroh-GAH-doo.
back: I was told that the deadline would be extended.
context: Very formal passive with an indirect object pronoun ('foi-me dito'). In everyday speech: 'me disseram que o prazo ia ser prorrogado'.
